title: Drinking to spite Nazarro, and his later two sets of books
summary: Bubbles got drunk on set to undercut Nazarro, who kept the studio going all night; Nazarro later died with two sets of books.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: That's right. But he really, not like him to get that way -- let him -- God rest his soul. However, getting back where I was trying to explain to you concerning the two checks. That showed me he was stealing. I didn't know that. Instead of me discarding him from that point on I went on like nothing had happened, but I figured I'd fix it so he wouldn't be -- I would be so reliable, not thinking of nothing but him. Not myself now. Thinking about him. If I'm under allowed, he can't do nothing, but I'm hurting myself. I ain't thinking about that. I ain't thinking about hurting myself, I'm just thinking about hurting him. But I'm hurting myself. So I would get drunk so he couldn't depend on me. Get my point? It got to a place where he thought liquor would rule me. So he would keep the studio going all night, get a flask and bring it in to give me a drink with the flask to keep me awake. Half the time I was
asleep, my eyes half-closed. Cameras going with my eyes closed. They'd wake me up to drink. Makes me look like I took dope or something, you know.

I let that slide. Oh, man, what I went through, I can't tell you because it will come out. However, he died with two sets of books, one for him and one for the government. They got him. They find the books. That fixed him up. He was dead three days before they found out he was dead.
So I am now thinking about how I'm going to do. And I don't think about getting none of my material that he's got in the office of where I played and what I've been in. I don't think about that.
